id.description: approval identifier from secret_request, or ask identifier from secret_ask_human

overwrite.description: replace an existing secret at the reference

prompt.description: what to ask the human for, for example: the Hetzner API token for project web

ref.description: reference to store the value at

store.description: store to write to when the reference does not name one

timeout_seconds.description: how long the human has to answer, default 900

wait_seconds.description: how long to wait for the answer before returning pending, default 120, at most 600

command.description: program and arguments to run, without a shell, for example ["gh","api","-X","POST","/user/tokens"]

json_path.description: take the value at this path of the JSON output, for example .token

overwrite.description: replace an existing secret at the reference

pattern.description: take the first capture group of this regular expression

ref.description: reference to store the captured value at

store.description: store to write to when the reference does not name one

charset.description: for chars: alnum (default), alnum-symbols, alpha, lower, digits

format.description: chars (default), hex, base64, base64url, uuid or passphrase

length.description: number of characters, default 32, between 8 and 4096

overwrite.description: replace an existing secret at the reference

ref.description: reference to store the generated value at, for example bao://kv/agents/app-db#password

separator.description: for passphrase: separator between words, default -

store.description: store to write to when the reference does not name one

words.description: for passphrase: number of words, default 6

duration.description: how long the grant should last, for example 30m or 2h

reason.description: why the secret is needed, shown to the approver

ref.description: reference of the secret, for example bao://kv/agents/hetzner

binding.description: only secrets bound to this host

prefix.description: only references starting with this prefix, for example bao://kv/agents/
